_comment: The El Nino status the Weather tab shows at the top. HAND-MAINTAINED.
NOAA's Climate Prediction Center issues its ENSO Diagnostic Discussion on
the second Thursday of each month. When a new one is out, copy its issue
date, alert status, synopsis and next date in here, bump the version and
the cache name, and push. The app says out loud when `next` has passed,
so a stale file is visible rather than silently wrong.
These dates are CPC's publication dates, not dates of the trip.
synopsis: El Niño continues to strengthen, with a strong-to-very strong El Niño likely through January-March 2027 (remaining greater than a 79% chance).
historic: Chances of a historic event, stronger than any El Niño back to 1950, are about 60% for October-December and November-January.
source: NOAA Climate Prediction Center, ENSO Diagnostic Discussion
